subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (AvaTech)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@avatech.com>; Carlos Medina <c.medina@avatech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (AvaTech)

Hi Samantha / Carlos 


Thanks again for taking the time today to walk your buying committee through the Redwood demo. Appreciate the thoughtful questions 

I wanted to capture the decisions we heard, stakeholder mapping, and clear next steps so everyone has the same view.

Quick recap of the committee we met with:
- Samantha Park (Head of AI/Product) 
  - economic buyer; cares about latency, developer experience, and rollout controls
- Carlos Medina (Infosec lead) 
  - security/compliance owner; SOC 2, data residency, and audit log needs
- Maria Lopez (Procurement, not on call) 
  - procurement/contracting (T&Cs, PO, payment terms)
- Todd Reynolds (Eng manager) 
  - evaluation owner; performance/throughput testing and integration plan

Decision criteria called out by the group:
1) Latency & reliability within production SLOs (p95 target < 250ms for async workloads)
2) Clear security controls (SOC 2, VPC options, KMS integration)
3) Predictable pricing and a path to Dedicated capacity as usage scales
4) Smooth procurement (standard SaaS terms preferred; limited redlines)

Action items / next steps (owners & timing):
- Redwood: send SOC 2 summary + short answers to Carlos' questionnaire (we attached the one-pager) 
  - owner: Marissa 
  - by EOD Fri 7/17. [attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf]
- AvaTech: share procurement contact and standard PO flow; Carlos to intro Maria to Marissa 
  - owner: Samantha 
  - by Mon 7/20
- Redwood: provide a draft SOW and indicative pricing for Dedicated + hosted fallback plan 
  - owner: Ben 
  - draft by Mon 7/20 [attachment: SOW-draft-avatech-v1.docx]
- AvaTech: schedule 1-2 hour perf run with Todd and Eng team (Redwood to provide test harness) 
  - owner: Todd/Samantha 
  - target the week of 7/27

Open questions we flagged on the call:
- Data residency: are EU servers required for initial rollout or only later? (Samantha to confirm)
- Any special contractual clauses required by procurement beyond standard security addendum? (Maria)

Proposed immediate milestone: SOC 2 + procurement intro this week to unblock a short pilot. If that looks good I can also propose a 2-week pilot scope for the perf run.

Thanks 

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Marissa 


Great summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Maria (Procurement) is looped in on this reply (procure@avatech.com). She’ll own the PO and standard terms review.
- Carlos will send over the Infosec questionnaire we use; if you can return the short answers by Friday that would be ideal.
- For data residency: initial rollout will be US-only; we’ll plan EU requirements for later phases.

We’re good to proceed with the perf run. Todd will reach out to coordinate windows and will need the test harness + API keys (ephemeral preferred). Also — can you confirm whether Dedicated is required for the pilot or if hosted API with guaranteed throughput is sufficient for initial testing? That influences the SOW.

Samantha Park
